plan.name: Remember delivered statues and keep task names unique
plan.summary: After onDeliver resolves, record the task through the existing setDismissedStatueTaskId helper so reload recovery skips completed deliveries; pending or rejected deliveries remain recoverable unless explicitly cleared, and unavailable storage retains today's best-effort recovery. Name fresh deliveries <photo-basename>-statue-<task-id>.stl, stripping only the photo's final extension as today, and recovered deliveries recovered-statue-<task-id>.stl, using the sidecar's full 12-character ID so different tasks have different names; retries of a rejected delivery on the same page keep its name, while recovery after a reload may use the recovered name because the photo name is no longer known. Preserve starting, the four-second polling wait, stopping on the fifth consecutive poll failure and resetting that count after a response, the ten-minute recovery window, Clear allowing in-flight delivery to finish, the one-task guard, delivery metadata and all messages. Update the name and successful-delivery storage expectations throughout lib/__tests__/statue-task.accept.test.ts, replace its deliberately preserved duplicate-recovery and colliding-name assertions with the fixed behavior, and retain its other coverage. Update README.md's hook description to explain photo-based and recovered names with task IDs, remembering completed delivery and the storage limitation.

tests.name: Remember fresh delivery after completion
tests.says: A fresh task stays guarded and unrecorded while delivery is pending; after delivery resolves it is remembered through the existing dismissal store and is not polled, downloaded or delivered again on reload.
tests.selector: statue delivery identity remembers fresh delivery only after completion and skips it on reload

tests.name: Remember recovered delivery and allow the next task
tests.says: A completed recovery is remembered and skipped after remount, but a different eligible latest task is still adopted and replaces the remembered ID only when its delivery completes.
tests.selector: statue delivery identity remembers recovered delivery while allowing a different latest task

tests.name: Unique names for fresh and recovered statues
tests.says: Fresh tasks from identically named lucy.jpg photos use lucy-statue-<full-task-id>.stl, and recovered tasks use recovered-statue-<full-task-id>.stl, so distinct 12-character IDs sharing a prefix still produce distinct library names.
tests.selector: statue delivery identity gives fresh and recovered tasks distinct names even when their ID prefixes match

tests.name: Retry rejected deliveries after reload
tests.says: Rejected fresh and recovered callbacks preserve the previous remembered ID and expose the original error; after reload, the fresh task uses its recovered name, subsequent recovery keeps that name, and only a successful callback records completion.
tests.selector: statue delivery identity retries rejected delivery after reload using the recovered task name

tests.name: Best-effort storage and task names
tests.says: Throwing storage reads or writes and a missing localStorage do not turn a completed delivery into an error; recovery can still redeliver as before, with the full task ID in both the original photo-based name and the stable recovered name.
tests.selector: statue delivery identity retains recovery and task names when localStorage is unavailable

tests.name: Stable names through retries on the same page
tests.says: When a callback change reconsiders the same latest task after a rejected delivery without remounting the hook, fresh and recovered tasks keep their original name, hold the one-task guard during delivery, and record completion only after success.
tests.selector: statue delivery identity keeps rejected fresh and recovered task names when retried on the same page
